recipe.title: How does changing the starting angle and length of a pendulum affect its swing period?
recipe.description: How does changing the starting angle and length of a pendulum affect its swing period?
assumptions: Ideal rigid-rod pendulum released at rest, starting angle 0–90°. No friction or air resistance.

Nonlinear motion solves θ″=−(g/L)sinθ using the elliptic time coordinate. The calculated period is 4√(L/g)K(sin(amplitude/2)); motion is independent of frame rate. Changing length, gravity or starting angle restarts the run.
Comparisons use shared gravity and initial amplitude. Length is the independent variable.
